info.title: ReTurn Server API
info.description: Home-LAN second brain. Single user, multiple devices (macOS / iOS / Windows). Write endpoints are deliberately unauthenticated inside the trusted LAN. POST /api/health always requires HEALTH_TOKEN. If API_TOKEN is configured, every endpoint except /api/ping and /api/health requires it via X-Return-Token or Bearer authorization.

servers.description: Orange Pi on the home LAN

post.summary: Register or re-register a client device

get.summary: List nodes for a calendar day

delete.summary: Delete a node and its derived edges / search index

post.summary: Upload audio; transcribe and store as a voice node

client_uuid.description: Idempotency key; must be a valid UUID

post.summary: Report daily sleep / steps (idempotent per date)
Nightly checkpoint: ferment, settle stats, write cards (idempotent per date)

post.summary: RAG question over past records, answer with citations
Input triage + workflow (idea / retrieval / question / task)

post.summary: Short-break recap of the last few hours
